title: Apple Events
excerpt: Introducing the iPhone Duo. Plus new iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and AirPods 5.
content_html:
Apple Event

Introducing iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and AirPods 5.

Video replay of today’s event will be available shortly.

Video replay of today’s event will be available shortly.

Here’s what we announced.

iPhone Duo

The largest iPhone display ever. Foldable, posable, standable. Featuring unique iOS experiences for ultimate versatility.

iPhone 18 Pro

The longest battery life in an iPhone.1 New 48MP Fusion Main camera with variable aperture for more creative control. Four gorgeous colors, two great sizes, one durable design.

Apple Watch Series 12

All-new Health Sensing System delivers the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable.2 More frequent HRV readings help provide insights on stress and recovery.

Apple Watch Ultra 4

The longest battery life of any Apple Watch. Now with up to 45 hours of Max Extended Workout tracking.3

AirPods 5

Up to 1.5x more Active Noise Cancellation than the previous generation.4 Featuring even better sound quality with a new acoustic architecture.
